contests.title: Pardeeville Area School District — School facility bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Pardeeville Area School District, Columbia and Marquette Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to issue pursuant to Chapter 67 of the Wisconsin Statutes, general obligation bonds in an amount not to exceed $13,100,000 for the public purpose of paying the cost of a school facility improvement project consisting of: construction of an addition and renovations at the Middle/High School, including for classrooms and instructional space, restrooms, a cafeteria and a safe and secure entrance; demolition of the Balliet building; renovations at the High School, including to restrooms and for expansion of the existing kitchen/cafeteria; district-wide capital improvement projects identified in the district's capital improvement plan; and acquisition of furnishings, fixtures and equipment?

contests.title: West De Pere School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote: Shall the School District of West De Pere, Brown and Outagamie Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $4,900,000 per year for five years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2031-2032 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational and maintenance expenses?

contests.title: Westfield School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote: Shall the School District of Westfield, Marquette, Waushara and Adams Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,400,000 per year for five years, beginning with the 2026-2027 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational expenses related to transportation, staffing, academic programming, curriculum updates, and career/trade pathways?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to borrow up to $13.1 million through general-obligation bonds for school facilities. Projects include a Middle/High School addition and renovations for classrooms, instructional spaces, restrooms, a cafeteria and secure entrance; demolition of the Balliet building; High School restroom renovations and expansion of the existing kitchen/cafeteria; major projects in the district’s capital improvement plan; and furnishings, fixtures and equipment.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize up to $13.1 million in bonds for these school-facility projects.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize these bonds through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $4.9 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for five school years, from 2027–28 through 2031–32, for operations and maintenance. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $1.4 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for five school years, from 2026–27 through 2030–31. It would support transportation, staffing, academic programs, curriculum updates and career or trade pathways. The authorization ends after those years.
